notes: New Community Macros gallery: browse, download and share macros with other players
Share your own macros under a Community Username — your email is never shown
Search the gallery by name, sort by top downloaded or newest, and manage your uploads
Smaller, rounded tooltips and other polish
Tooltips are smaller and rounded so they fit their text
New macros now open in Steps mode — the simpler way to build a macro
Sign in with your Reflex account to activate without typing your key
Updated the End User License Agreement — you'll be asked to accept it once on your next launch
Fixed: once your PC is activated, Reflex no longer asks for your key again after you quit and reopen it
Your PC's activation is now locked in so it stays bound across restarts
Turn steps now have a duration field (ms) for how long the turn takes
Hide or show the macro list and settings panels with the top-bar chevrons
"Learn more" links in the settings open the matching docs section
Macro titles are capped at 24 characters
New macros start as an empty script, switchable to Steps
Toggle macros now have an in-app Active switch — start or stop them without a keybind
